notes: Conditionals (COND) is a plain fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 COND (1e27 base units) once to msg.sender, the factory. It has no owner, no external mint or burn, no fees, no pause or blacklist, and no upgrade mechanism, so every launch flow moves exactly the amount stated. No application contracts are deployed with this launch.
